svg.text: Tier 3: All The Things Wiring Diagram
Everything from Tier 2 + 2nd climate node, 4 LED channels, load cell, door contact, peristaltic pump, 4 smart plugs, 2nd camera
ESP32 | USB-C 5V | STEMMA QT chain: SHT31-D → SCD41 → BH1750
ESP32 | USB-C 5V | Identical STEMMA QT chain: SHT31-D + SCD41 + BH1750
Separate shelf. Same sensor addresses (different ESP32).
ESP32 | USB-C 5V | 4 MOSFET channels + HX711 load cell + door contact (reed)
MOSFET Channels (see Tier 2 for circuit detail)
CH0: FAE, CH1: Exhaust, CH2: Circulation
100R gate, 10K pull-down, UF4007 flyback. 60 s max-on default.
3.3V --> VIN, GND --> GND. Cell: red E+, black E−, signal A−/A+. 10 SPS.
GPIO 35 --> COM; alarm NC --> GND (closed = door shut)
Wired on NO instead? Tick the invert box (reed_inv)
ESP32 | USB-C 5V | 4 MOSFET channels, 10-bit PWM, no diodes (LED strips are resistive)
ESP32-CAM | OV2640 or OV3660 | ESP32-CAM-MB micro-USB 5V
cam-01: front view. No GPIO wiring.
ESP32-CAM | OV2640 or OV3660 | ESP32-CAM-MB micro-USB 5V
cam-02: top-down view. No GPIO wiring.
Fans + strips + pump via MOSFET drains. Keep ≤ ~8 A: cut strips to length
No wiring. User sp-3p, Topic = role, Full Topic tasmota/%topic%/%prefix%/ (required)
Plugs 3 + 4 are new in Tier 3. Keep every plug outside the chamber; heater ≤ 1500 W on one plug.
Wiring Steps -- Tier 3 Additions (on top of Tier 2)
Same STEMMA QT chain as Node 1:
HX711 Load Cell (NEW on Relay Node):
6. Alarm NC terminal --> GND (closed = door shut)
Wired on NO? Tick the portal's invert box (reed_inv).
CH2: Red 660nm (GPIO 27) -- tri-spectrum RED wire, same circuit (no diode)
CH3: Far-Red 730nm (GPIO 14) -- tri-spectrum GREEN wire, same circuit
ESP32-CAM on its own ESP32-CAM-MB (micro-USB 5V). No GPIO wiring. Top-down, cam-02.
Plug 3: Dehumidifier, Plug 4: Peltier Cooler (Plug 2 = space heater).
WiFi only: user sp-3p, Topic = role, Full Topic tasmota/%topic%/%prefix%/.
Peristaltic pump on relay CH3 (aux, GPIO 14): IRLZ44N + UF4007, 60 s max-on by default.
